title: The Former Divine Dragon Reincarnated as a Puny Human, but Is Still Unrivaled
description:
Young Asbal has a secret: in his previous life, he was Bahamut, the Divine Dragon who protected the kingdom 300 years ago.

Though he finds the frailty of his puny human body frustrating, he enjoys peaceful, happy days with his older sister. But one day, while mining ore to buy medicine for her, he suddenly finds himself in a desperate predicament. Just as things take a turn for the worse, a pair of dragon wings sprout from his back…!

To make matters worse, the military, which has been searching for the reincarnation of the Divine Dragon, catches wind of his existence…

Armed with the power of a dragon, he embarks on an unstoppable adventure to protect his family!
author: Jun Miura
